correctness.rationale: The two hyperedges are the entire vertex set; each is odd and neither contains the other. If both inactive, shared vertices force global consensus. The first effective clock event chooses uniformly among active groups. After one group becomes monochrome, only the other can act; after it acts, the two private blocks have fixed opposing opinions. Every subsequent shared-block flip is dominated by its private block exactly when 2s<a and 2s<b, yielding a closed alternating class; otherwise consensus occurs within four effective updates. Fair-initial averaging correctly includes the sole-active clock correction. An independently written state enumerator (not the supplied verify.py) checked every labelled configuration in six structures including (3,3,1),(5,5,s=1,2,3),(3,5,1),(5,7,2), and reproduced probabilities 1/4,5/16,1/8,0,9/32,5/32.
